text:
Please contact poison control or a doctor right now about your toddler. Don't wait on anything else, and keep the plant out of reach. I can't advise on the medical side, but they can tell you what to do.

Once your child is looked after, report the smashed pot within **48 hours** of delivery, with photos of the plant and the box. Since the pot is smashed, this counts as damaged on arrival. You can choose a free replacement on the next plant shipping day or a refund, and the replacement won't use up your Plant Care Guarantee replacement.

I'm sorry this happened, and I hope your little one is okay.
